name: Pride in the Name of Love

podcast.title: Translucent Australian 12-inch Single
podcast.body: A translucent 45 RPM 12-inch single issued in Australia through Festival, a subsidiary label of Island Records, in 1984. Side one features "Pride in the Name of Love," while side B includes two versions of "Boomerang" and "Fourth of July." Only about 50 copies of this 12-inch were pressed, and when they come to market, they are known to sell for around $9,000 US dollars (approximately $12,000 Canadian). "If we go back to 1984, the band issued a translucent 45 RPM 12 inch single for Pride in the name of love in Australia through a subsidiary label of Island Records called Festival."
